user.title: PHS16-LC
user.description: RS-485 full-duplex bus of PHS16-LC luminaires. Plug in the USB-RS422 (FTDI) adapter before continuing.

data.expected_spots: Expected number of SPOTs (0 = scan stops at first silence)
data.rx_port: RX serial port (optional — dual box with 2x USB-RS485-WE)

data_description.port: Linux: /dev/ttyUSB0 (or /dev/phs16bus with a udev rule). macOS (dev): /dev/cu.usbserial-XXXX.
data_description.expected_spots: Set the total number of luminaires to detect a failed card in the middle of the line.
data_description.poll_interval: The PHS16-LC protocol has no push: currents and temperatures are re-read at this interval.
data_description.recipes_dir: Copy the recipes/*.json files from the project there; they feed the "Recipe" dropdowns.
data_description.rx_port: Leave empty for a single full-duplex converter (TX = RX). With the manufacturer dual box: TX port in "Serial port", RX port here.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

init.title: PHS16-LC options
init.description: Applied live: the entry is reloaded automatically after saving. If the port changes, the old port is closed and the new one opened.

data.rx_port: RX port (optional — dual box with 2x USB-RS485-WE)
data.expected_spots: Expected number of SPOTs (0 = scan stops at first silence)

data_description.port: Linux: /dev/ttyUSB0 (or /dev/phs16bus with a udev rule). macOS (dev): /dev/cu.usbserial-XXXX.
data_description.rx_port: Empty = single full-duplex converter (TX = RX). Dual box: RX port here, TX port in "Serial port".

error.already_configured: This serial port is already used by another PHS16-LC entry.

scan.name: Scan the line
scan.description: Searches for PHS16-LC cards present on the bus (addresses 1..N).

apply_recipe.name: Apply a recipe
apply_recipe.description: Applies a recipe to one card, to all (address=all) or to a whole luminaire group (address=group:<id>).

address.name: Address
address.description: Card number (e.g. "1"), "all" (all cards) or "group:<id>" (luminaire group defined in groups.json).

group.name: Group
group.description: Optional: apply only this channel group (partial application).

apply_scene.name: Apply a scene
apply_scene.description: Applies a scene file to several cards at once.

file.name: Scene file
file.description: File name in the scenes folder (e.g. "serre.json").

save.name: Save to NVM
save.description: Sends @WP after each card (makes currents permanent).

save.name: Save to NVM
save.description: Makes the card's current channel currents permanent in non-volatile memory (@WP).

set_channels.name: Set channels
set_channels.description: Sets each channel individually (16 values in mA, 0 = off, 74-2150 mA).

currents.name: Currents (mA)
currents.description: 16 values separated by spaces or commas (e.g. "800 800 0 0 ...").

set_channel.name: Set one channel
set_channel.description: Sets a single channel of a card.
